name: Leech
meaning: draw the life out of what you strike, into yourself
why: The shadow knight's own verb. From Dark's Devour (swallow) and Death's ending. A Link (it takes in from the target and passes on to you), draw +0.8 because it pulls inward.

name: Outpour
meaning: let out what you took, as harm
why: Spends the stolen store. From Dark's Disgorge. A Branch (it spreads into a cone), draw -0.8: it gives outward; opposite Leech, so the pair bonds ionically.

name: Daunt
meaning: fear that drives them back from you
why: Fear is in the role. From Death's Haunt and Dark's fear of the dark. Named Daunt, not Dread, because Dread is Dream's rune. A Branch (it spreads to all round you), draw -0.6: it pushes outward. It applies Dream's existing Terrified rather than a new fear status.

name: Beckon
meaning: the dark calls them in, and does not let them go
why: A tank's way to reach a runner. From Dark's Pin (the shadow holds). A Link, draw +0.7: it draws inward.

name: Gloom
meaning: darkness that hangs about you and goes where you go
why: Dark auras are in the role. From Dark's Darken and Obscure. A Branch (it spreads round you), draw -0.4: outward, but gently.

name: Shroud
meaning: darkness drawn tight onto your own body
why: The ward. From Dark's Obscure and Death's Preserve. A Frame (it holds the structure, and you, together), draw +0.5: it holds inward. Gloom and Shroud are one dark, spread out or drawn in.

name: Reave
meaning: tear out the last of a failing life and keep it
why: From Death's Kill. A Cap (it ends: a killing blow), draw +1.0 like Kill and Devour, the two runes it comes from: it takes everything inward.

name: Torment
why: From Death's Spare, turned cruel. A Link (it passes the life on to you a little at a time), draw -0.3: it lets the life go slowly rather than taking it.

name: Stalk
meaning: come at your prey through the dark and do not let it go
why: Movement for a melee fighter: in, not away. From Dark's Shadowstep. A Link, draw +0.4: it closes inward.

name: Forsake
meaning: break away, and leave dread on the ground behind you
why: The disengage, still in role (it leaves fear). From Death's Haunt and Vanish. A Link, draw -0.6: it goes outward, away.
